'''Anthony Payne ewok and turn him''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Anthony Payne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10404">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10404 ewok and turn him], DeckTech (anthony "yodap" payne, 14 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10404/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10404/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018121227/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10404/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Anthony Payne]]
* '''Published:''' 14 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ewok and turn him''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif|label=There Is Good In Him}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 TIGIH Payne LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' this deck uses there is good in him to deplete the opponents life force, and to help out, we have ewoks to battle them.

== Original post ==

'''ewok and turn him'''
* '''Author:''' anthony "yodap" payne
* '''Published:''' September 14, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' this deck uses there is good in him to deplete the opponents life force, and to help out, we have ewoks to battle them.

=== Strategy ===

This is a mix deck, its one part objective (there s good in him/i can save him) and 2 part ewok deck  first you use the ewoks to beat your opponent in battles, therefor stacking a card on to "i feel the conflict". then you devestate your opponent by turning vader, and depleting his life force pretty cool huh?

any way, the ewoks in there all get power from DOS, ithorians and wokling....at back door, or hiddem trail, they are at leats +4 or more depending on how many ithorians you have Then there is chewie just to have some fun with...that makes for a kick @#$% deck that you can win with even withou completing the objective
